facts.fact: The ROA-BN chairman, who heads Mali's Societe malienne de transmission, said the network is operational and Mali is connected to Cote d'Ivoire, Guinea and Senegal.
The ROA-BN chairman said Mali is connected to Guinea within the operational eight-country backbone network, whose headquarters opened in Conakry on 10 November 2025.
The ROA-BN chairman said Mali is connected to Senegal within the operational eight-country backbone network, and that Senegal's internet connection can transit Mali and be backed up via Guinea.
